logger.doc:name: set final logger to update method
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy"}, level: Mule::p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: vars.env, apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: attributes.method, details:{ message: "Customer successfully put into PAPI.", affected_rows: payload.affectedRows default 1 , data_updated: payload.new_data } }]

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "log_type": "SYSTEM_API_ERROR", "API_NAME": app.name, "correlation_id": vars.correlationId, "flow_name": flow.name, httpMethod: attributes.method, "timestamp": now(), "details": { "target_id": attributes.uriParams.id default "UNKNOWN", "error_type": (error.errorType.namespace default "DB") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN"), "error_description": error.description default "No description available", "message": "Failed to "++ attributes.method ++ " customer from PAPI." } }]
